page.overview:
Who is Betty Cooper?

Betty Cooper is a character in Archie Comics.

She appeared on the front cover of an Archie Comics issue Homer Simpson read while he complained about the "stuck-up Riverdale punks".

When Jughead, Moose, Reggie, Betty, and Veronica Lodge pranked Bart Simpson with a quarter glued to the sidewalk, Jughead lamented that Archie was no longer alive to see it.
